mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) potentiates minoxidil's vasodilatory and hypotensive effects through inhibition of norepinephrine metabolism, increasing sympathomimetic activity and risk of severe hypotension and cardiac complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood pressure closely with dose adjustment; consider alternative antihypertensive or topical minoxidil formulations if hair loss treatment is necessary.
